text:
Toro saw their run of three straight wins ended by a 3-1 home defeat to Como in the midweek round. Alessio Cacciamani dislocated his shoulder in that game, joining Niccolò Fortini, Rolando Mandragora, Ricardo Rodriguez and Franco Israel on the treatment table.
Ilario Monterisi nodded over from an early corner, while Saul Coco sprinted back for a decisive block on Antonio Raimondo and Fares Ghedjemis fired over.
Raimondo’s acrobatic overhead kick skimmed the crossbar and another first-time strike flashed inches wide, but their top scorer was forced off on the half-hour mark after badly turning his ankle in a bookable offence by Zakaria Aboukhlal.
Aboukhlal ran a big risk on the stroke of half-time when colliding heavily with Lorenzo Palmisani as the goalkeeper rushed outside his box to clear a long ball.
Giacomo Calò saw his free kick palmed away by Lucas Perri, but Frosinone broke the deadlock with the first ever Serie A goal for Fares Ghedjemis.
He started the move and was ready to sweep in the finish from just inside the area into the near bottom corner after Giorgi Kvernadze took on Nikola Vlasic for the lay-off.
Frosinone thought they had to double their lead on 63 minutes when Perri gave it away to Daniel Birligea under pressure, but Ghedjemis was denied by a truly desperate Saul Coco block, the defender throwing his body in the way from eight yards.
Vlasic drilled inches wide moments later, but Perri had to make up for a poor goal kick by making the double save on Birligea at the near post.
Gaetano Oristanio blasted not far over the bar from outside the area, while the Ghedjemis curler off the left foot shaved a coat of paint off the far post.
Giacomo Calò came even closer at the 86th minute, his strike from distance clipping the outside of the far post, and another Ghedjemis effort just wide.
Calò went close several times, eventually getting his goal in added time with a right-foot curler from the edge of the box into the near top corner.
digest_he:
פרוזינונה המשיכה במומנטום הנהדר שלה בליגה המקומית וקטעה את רצף המשחקים של טורינו עם ניצחון ביתי מרשים. המשחק התפתח בקצב מהיר, כאשר המארחים נאלצו להסתדר ללא מלך השערים שלהם שנפצע ונאלץ לרדת מהמגרש בשלב מוקדם של המחצית הראשונה.

השער הראשון במשחק הגיע מרגליו של פארס ג'דג'מיס, שכבש את שער הבכורה שלו אי פעם בסרייה אה עם בעיטה מדויקת מתוך הרחבה לפינה הרחוקה. למרות ניסיונות חוזרים ונשנים של האורחים להשוות ולחץ רב מצד שחקני ההגנה, פרוזינונה שמרה על היתרון ובתוספת הזמן של המשחק ג'אקומו קאלו חתם את התוצאה עם בעיטה מסובבת נהדרת מקצה הרחבה לחיבורי הקורות.
